title: Pocketwire Business Profile Chargeback Fee Levels for Repeat Claims
content:
Schedule to the seller terms of the Pocketwire Business Profile. The chargeback fee level of a chargeback depends on how many chargebacks are dated on the profile within the rolling 12 months ending on the handling date. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

**Levels.** The chargeback fee level is 12.00 dollars when that chargeback is the only chargeback dated within the rolling 12 months ending on the handling date, 35.00 dollars when at least 3 chargebacks are dated in that window, and the tier's chargeback fee otherwise.

| Chargebacks dated in the rolling 12 months | Chargeback fee level |
|---|---|
| exactly one — the chargeback being priced | USD 12.00 |
| 3 or more | USD 35.00 |
| any other count | the tier's chargeback fee |

The tier's chargeback fee, in figures:

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chargeback fee | USD 20.00 | USD 20.00 | USD 20.00 | USD 15.00 | USD 15.00 | USD 10.00 |

Columns are the tiers Pocketwire Business Starter to Pocketwire Business Enterprise.

**Cases (hypothetical ledgers, handling date 10 May).**
- One chargeback on 2 May, none earlier in the window: USD 12.00.
- Chargebacks on 10 May of the previous year and on 2 May: the window covers the dates after 10 May of the previous year, so the first is outside it and only one counts: USD 12.00.
- Two chargebacks in the window, on Pocketwire Business Pro: USD 15.00.
- Three chargebacks in the window: USD 35.00.
